sheets.name: equations (1 column, working under each; photo)

texts.1: 1. Sam has 24 stickers. He gives \( 1 / 3 \) of them to his sister. ⏎ How many stickers does Sam have left? ⏎ \[ 24-8=16 \]
texts.2: 2. A rectangle is 7 cm long and 4 cm wide. ⏎ What is its area? ⏎ \[ 7 \times 4=28 \]
texts.3: 3. The table shows the hours Kim worked and her pay. ⏎ \begin{tabular}[t]{|l|l|l|l|l|} \hline Hours & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline Pay (\$) & 12 & 24 & 36 & ? \\ \hline \end{tabular} ⏎ 3. What is Kim's pay for 4 hours? ⏎ \[ 48 \]
texts.4: 4. A train travels 180 km in 3 hours. ⏎ What is its average speed? ⏎ \[ 180 \div 3=60 \]
